## 公式与配对证据

6672条ratio按100sqrt(E/S)重算，最大差0个百分点，未重复乘100。16篇token SHA/ID/mask/positions均核对；现存共享权重与source未变证据附JSON，不重新哈希整模型。

## 推测与尚缺实验

- 推测：Dynamic metadata changes and repeated nonlinear path differences may mediate propagation; saved flips alone do not establish causality.
- 未做ablation：Per-node/site one-at-a-time policy intervention on identical input and fixed weights.
- 未做ablation：Freeze versus recompute dynamic metadata under paired paths.
- 未做ablation：Separate final-layer Attention/MLP/residual contributions.
- 未做ablation：Final norm with matched normalization statistics versus each-path statistics.

这些是后续可证伪实验方向，本分析不启动模型、不调整Q001、不从现存比值宣称因果或精度通过。
